architecture: Native WPF UI + fixed-command Windows service + bundled protected PowerShell 7.6.6 backend; accepted direct DNS/DPI path plus non-privileged Router Gateway profile manager

features.routerGatewayRefresh: GitHub manifest + best-effort rotating credential refresh

usage.onlineUpdate: Service-mediated GitHub latest release update with GitHub asset digest + SHA256SUMS + downloaded-file SHA-256 verification.

limitations: PPTP is a legacy compatibility fallback; prefer L2TP/IPsec or OpenVPN.
Router VPN Client capability varies by exact model and firmware.
Endpoint reachability tests are health heuristics, not complete authenticated tunnel handshakes.
